searchSchema.description: Ductless split systems (1:1 mini splits and multi splits). Enter per-zone capacity targets; results include systems with at least one indoor unit matching.

notes: Provide with low ambient wind baffle for cooling down to 0°F
Provide with field installed condensate pump
Provide with field installed disconnect. Disconnect shall be provided and installed by electrical contractor
*Capacity listed is nominal capacity for this indoor unit.

compactSelections.about: Multi split systems (the MULTI SPLITS tab). Each system is [id, [rows], [filterValues]]: indexes into rows (in indoor unit order) and, per filterColumns entry, into that filter's filterValues list (-1 = blank). The site rebuilds normal selections from these on load (JS/data.js).
